\section[(dialogue)]{The body and the house — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R118-first-pass-the-body-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a plum and a squash.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an eyebrow, the skin, a bone, a carpet, a sofa
  \item a light bulb, a telephone, a computer, a television, a jug
  \item a tray, a bowl, a broom, a bucket, a rope
  \item a ladder, a chest, a suitcase, a backpack, a battery
  \item a card, a ticket, a stamp, an envelope, a pencil sharpener
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An eyebrow? (\textbf{\fa{ابرو}}, \emph{abru}.) The skin? (\textbf{\fa{پوست}}, \emph{pust}.) A bone? (\textbf{\fa{استخوان}}, \emph{ostokhân}.) A carpet? (\textbf{\fa{فرش}}, \emph{farsh}.) A sofa? (\textbf{\fa{مبل}}, \emph{mobl}.) A light bulb? (\textbf{\fa{لامپ}}, \emph{lâmp}.) A telephone? (\textbf{\fa{تلفن}}, \emph{telefon}.) A computer? (\textbf{\fa{کامپیوتر}}, \emph{kâmpyuter}.) A television? (\textbf{\fa{تلویزیون}}, \emph{televiziyon}.) A jug? (\textbf{\fa{پارچ}}, \emph{pârch}.) A tray? (\textbf{\fa{سینی}}, \emph{sini}.) A bowl? (\textbf{\fa{کاسه}}, \emph{kâse}.) A broom? (\textbf{\fa{جارو}}, \emph{jâru}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\fa{سطل}}, \emph{satl}.) A rope? (\textbf{\fa{طناب}}, \emph{tanâb}.) A ladder? (\textbf{\fa{نردبان}}, \emph{nardebân}.) A chest? (\textbf{\fa{صندوق}}, \emph{sanduq}.) A suitcase? (\textbf{\fa{چمدان}}, \emph{chamedân}.) A backpack? (\textbf{\fa{کوله} \fa{پشتی}}, \emph{kuleposhti}.) A battery? (\textbf{\fa{باتری}}, \emph{bâtri}.) A card? (\textbf{\fa{کارت}}, \emph{kârt}.) A ticket? (\textbf{\fa{بلیت}}, \emph{bilit}.) A stamp? (\textbf{\fa{تمبر}}, \emph{tamr}.) An envelope? (\textbf{\fa{پاکت}}, \emph{pâkat}.) A pencil sharpener? (\textbf{\fa{مدادتراش}}, \emph{medâdtarâsh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{School, work and getting around — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R118-second-pass-school-work-and-getting-around}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a ruler and a board.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a ruler, a board, a class, an exam, a teacher
  \item a pupil, a doctor, a nurse, a cook, a worker
  \item a farmer, a driver, a shopkeeper, a baker, a small child
  \item a grandchild, a taxi, the metro, a ship, an aeroplane
  \item a road, a car park, raisins, a plum, a squash
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A ruler? (\textbf{\fa{خط} \fa{کش}}, \emph{khatkesh}.) A board? (\textbf{\fa{تخته}}, \emph{takhte}.) A class? (\textbf{\fa{کلاس}}, \emph{kelâs}.) An exam? (\textbf{\fa{امتحان}}, \emph{emtehân}.) A teacher? (\textbf{\fa{آموزگار}}, \emph{âmuzgâr}.) A pupil? (\textbf{\fa{شاگرد}}, \emph{shâgerd}.) A doctor? (\textbf{\fa{دکتر}}, \emph{doktor}.) A nurse? (\textbf{\fa{پرستار}}, \emph{parastâr}.) A cook? (\textbf{\fa{آشپز}}, \emph{âshpaz}.) A worker? (\textbf{\fa{کارگر}}, \emph{kârgar}.) A farmer? (\textbf{\fa{کشاورز}}, \emph{keshâvarz}.) A driver? (\textbf{\fa{راننده}}, \emph{rânande}.) A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\fa{فروشنده}}, \emph{furushande}.) A baker? (\textbf{\fa{نانوا}}, \emph{nânvâ}.) A small child? (\textbf{\fa{کودک}}, \emph{kudak}.) A grandchild? (\textbf{\fa{نوه}}, \emph{nave}.) A taxi? (\textbf{\fa{تاکسی}}, \emph{tâksi}.) The metro? (\textbf{\fa{مترو}}, \emph{metro}.) A ship? (\textbf{\fa{کشتی}}, \emph{kashti}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\fa{هواپیما}}, \emph{havâpeymâ}.) A road? (\textbf{\fa{جاده}}, \emph{jâdde}.) A car park? (\textbf{\fa{پارکینگ}}, \emph{pârking}.) Raisins? (\textbf{\fa{کشمش}}, \emph{kishmish}.) A plum? (\textbf{\fa{آلو}}, \emph{âlu}.) A squash? (\textbf{\fa{کدو}}, \emph{kadu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
